# Accounts & Collections

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table workspace tab.

## Tabs

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Collection Follow-up](collection-follow-up.md) | `collection-follow-up` | Manages the end-to-end collection follow-up workflow for Accounts & Collections. |
| [Patient Accounts](patient-accounts.md) | `patient-accounts` | Provides a read-oriented patient accounts table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Patient Statements](patient-statements.md) | `patient-statements` | Provides a read-oriented patient statements table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |
| [Receivables](receivables.md) | `receivables` | Provides a read-oriented receivables table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed workspace tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
